app.name: Sajiyya
app.tagline: Your book, for your eyes only

meta.title: Sajiyya — your book, for your eyes only
meta.description: Read the book you bought after signing in, chapter by chapter, with no files to download or forward.

home.title: Your book, for your eyes only
home.lead: Read the book you bought after signing in, chapter by chapter, with no files to download or forward.

login.title: No password to remember
login.body: Enter your email and we send you a code to sign in with.

resume.title: Pick up where you left off
resume.body: Your reading position, font size and night mode are saved.

personal.title: Your copy, in your name
personal.body: Your name appears at the foot of every chapter, so the copy is yours alone.

login.title: Sign in
login.lead: Enter the email you bought the book with and we'll send you a sign-in code.
login.codeSent: If this email has a Sajiyya account, we've sent it a message. Open the link in it, or type the code if there is one. Check your spam folder too.

errors.invalidCode: That code is wrong or has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts in a short time. Wait a little and try again.
errors.generic: We couldn't complete that right now. Try again shortly.
errors.link: That sign-in link didn't work: it may have expired or been opened in a different browser from the one that asked for it. Ask for a new link and open it in the same browser.

library.title: My library
library.empty: There are no books in your library yet. If you just bought one, it can take a few minutes to appear.

install.android: Install Sajiyya on your home screen so it opens like an app, without the browser bar.
install.ios: To add Sajiyya to your home screen: tap Share in Safari, then "Add to Home Screen".

errors.notEntitled: This book isn't in your library.
errors.deviceLimit: This account is already open on two devices, which is the limit. Contact us to remove an old device.
errors.deviceRevoked: This device was removed from your account. Contact us if that's a mistake.
errors.inactive: This account is suspended. Contact us if that's a mistake.
errors.generic: We couldn't open this page right now. Try again shortly.

admin.title: Owner panel
admin.name: Name (shown at the foot of reading pages)
admin.linked: Reader added and the book is open to them. They sign in with their email and a code.
admin.invited: Reader invited. The book opens when they first sign in with their email and a code.
admin.noBooks: There are no books yet. Import the book first.

salla.title: Salla link
salla.lead: Link a Salla product SKU to a book. The book unlocks for the buyer after payment and locks again on cancellation or refund.

admin.noTestResults: Nobody has started the test yet.
admin.testPanelLead: Readers and their results, each result in detail, a trial run of the test, and the path choice. The test panel itself is in Arabic, as designed.

mail.skipped: No welcome email was sent: email is not set up yet (RESEND_API_KEY and MAIL_FROM).
mail.failed: The welcome email could not be sent. Try “Resend welcome” later.

overrides.lead: What you hide or replace here is for this reader only; everyone else keeps the shared book.
overrides.replaceHint: Leave empty for the shared text. Written like the book (Markdown).
overrides.loadError: Could not load the chapters. Close the list and open it again.
overrides.edition: For a wholly different edition: import it as its own book and link it to this reader only.
overrides.firstStays: The first chapter always stays (it carries the support line).
overrides.replaceHintFirst: Leave empty for the shared text. Replacement text for the first chapter must open with the exact support line.
overrides.supportLine: The support line must open the first chapter exactly, and appear nowhere else.

bookImport.title: Books
bookImport.lead: Upload the chapter files, check the preview, then publish.
bookImport.filesHint: One file per chapter, named with its order number first, or one file split at its "## " headings. A first line starting with "#" or "##" is the chapter title.
bookImport.supportAdded: The support line was added at the start of chapter one.
bookImport.digits: Digits or percent signs on {n} lines: please check

problems.support-line: The support line must open chapter one, once, and appear nowhere else.
problems.title: A chapter has no title.
problems.empty: No chapters found in the files.
problems.tooLarge: A chapter is larger than allowed.

bookImport.published: Book published: {n} chapters. Link it to readers from the owner panel.

errors.notOwner: This page is for the owner only.
errors.noServiceKey: The service key is not set in Vercel (SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY).
errors.invalidBook: Check the type code, slug and title (the slug is lowercase letters, digits and dashes).
errors.fewerChapters: The new version has fewer chapters than the current one, and chapters are never deleted. Add the missing chapters or publish under a new slug.
errors.invalidChapter: A chapter is invalid (no title or no text).
errors.supportLine: The support line must open chapter one, once, and appear nowhere else.
errors.tooLarge: The file is larger than allowed.
errors.notFound: The book does not exist yet. Publish it first.
errors.invalidFigure: Name images with plain letters and digits, ending in png, jpg, webp or gif.
errors.slugTaken: That slug belongs to an existing book. Choose "Update an existing book" or change the slug.
errors.migrationPending: Taking a book down needs the database migration 20261105060000_book_active first.

bookImport.figuresLead: Uploaded to the book's private image store, and referenced in the text as ![caption](الأشكال/name.png). An image with the same name is replaced.
bookImport.savedChapter: Chapter saved. Readers with their own replacement text for this chapter keep theirs.
bookImport.takeDownConfirm: The book will be hidden from every reader's library and can't be opened. Nothing in it is erased and you can put it back at any time. If it is linked to a Salla product, unlink that first so it is not sold. Continue?
bookImport.discardChanges: This chapter has unsaved changes. Discard them?

test.title: Type test
test.lead: Answer as you are when nobody asks anything of you. Your answers are saved to your account as you go. The test itself is in Arabic.
test.timeLeft: Time left since you opened it
test.loadError: The test could not load right now. Refresh the page in a moment.

welcome.subject: Welcome to {app}
welcome.body: A book is waiting for you in {app}. Sign in with this email address and you will get a code or a link; there is no password.
welcome.footer: If you were not expecting this message, you can ignore it.

legal.contact: To contact us, or to ask for your account and data to be deleted:
legal.contactFallback: To contact us, or to ask for your account and data to be deleted, write to the store you bought from.

privacy.title: What we collect
privacy.body: Your email and name, to sign you in and show your copy in your name. An identifier for each device you read on, since each account has two devices. Your reading history: which chapter you opened, when, and where you stopped, so you can carry on. The reading settings you choose. Your answers in the type test, if you take it.

privacy.title: How we use it
privacy.body: Only to run the service: signing in, opening your books on your devices, keeping your place, and showing your test result. The app's owner sees this data to manage accounts and devices.

privacy.title: What we do not do
privacy.body: We do not sell your data or share it for advertising, and the app has no ads or advertising trackers.

privacy.title: Where it is kept
privacy.body: With the services the app runs on: Supabase for accounts and the database, Vercel for hosting, Resend for email, and Salla if you bought there.

privacy.title: The books
privacy.body: Books are never downloaded and their files are never sent. The text is shown only inside the app, with your name and email at the foot of each chapter.

privacy.title: Your account
privacy.body: We do not delete accounts on our own; an account is only suspended when needed. You can ask for your account and data to be deleted at any time by email.

terms.title: The service
terms.body: In this app you read the books you bought, after signing in with your email.

terms.title: Your account
terms.body: Your account is personal and not to be shared. Each account has two devices; to remove an old one, contact us.

terms.title: Allowed use
terms.body: Personal reading only. Copying, photographing or republishing the text, or sharing your account, is not allowed.

terms.title: Suspension
terms.body: An account may be suspended if these terms are broken, or if the purchase is refunded.

terms.title: The type test
terms.body: The test is a tool for self-knowledge, not a medical or psychological diagnosis.

terms.title: Changes
terms.body: We may update these terms, and every update is published on this page.

type.testLead: Short questions that find your type.
